complaints.title: Complaints Book
complaints.subtitle: Virtual complaint form (Libro de Reclamaciones)
complaints.notice: As required by Peru's Consumer Protection and Defense Code, we have a Complaints Book available to you.

fields.accepted: I declare this information is true and authorize Grupo Fazzilito E.I.R.L. to use it to handle this complaint, under Peru's Personal Data Protection Law No. 29733.

kindHelp.reclamo: Disagreement about the products or services.
kindHelp.queja: Disagreement not about the products or services, or dissatisfaction with how you were attended.

legal.deadline: The provider must answer the claim or complaint within fifteen (15) non-extendable business days.
legal.otherWays: Filing a claim does not prevent you from using other dispute resolution channels, nor is it a prerequisite for filing a complaint with INDECOPI.

success.title: Your complaint was registered
success.body: Your complaint form No. {code} was registered. We sent a copy to {email}.
success.due: We will answer by {date} at the latest.

errors.name: Write your full name.
errors.doc_ce: A foreigner ID has 8 to 12 characters.
errors.guardian: Write your parent or guardian's name.
errors.detail: Tell us the details (at least 10 characters).
errors.generic: We couldn't register your complaint. Try again or write to {email}.
errors.rate: You sent several complaints in a row. Wait a moment and try again.

email.receiptSubject: Receipt for your complaint form No. {code} – Whasalia
email.receiptIntro:
Hello {name},

We registered your complaint form No. {code} in Whasalia's Complaints Book. This is your receipt.
email.noticeIntro: Complaint form No. {code} was registered. It must be answered by {date} from Superadmin → Complaints.
email.answerSubject: Answer to your complaint form No. {code} – Whasalia
email.answerIntro:
Hello {name},

This is our answer to your complaint form No. {code}:

complaintsAdmin.title: Complaints Book
complaintsAdmin.subtitle: Complaint forms from the website. Each must be answered within 15 business days; the answer is emailed to the consumer.
complaintsAdmin.select: Choose a complaint to see it.
complaintsAdmin.responsePlaceholder: Explain what you did or what solution you offer (emailed to the consumer).
complaintsAdmin.sendFailed: We couldn't send the answer. Try again.
